edges: Dieppe-Le Treport has acquired a 29.5% interest in two French offshore wind farms owned by a consortium including ENGIE.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: ENGIE remains a reference shareholder at 31 percent and is a leading industrial player in two projects of 496 MW each, in partnership with Sumitomo Corporation.

edges: The deal covers two 496 MW wind farms at Yeu-Noirmoutier and Dieppe-Le Treport.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: ENGIE remains a reference shareholder at 31 percent and is a leading industrial player in two projects of 496 MW each, in partnership with Sumitomo Corporation.
Sumitomo Corporation is a long-time partner of ENGIE, co-investing in desalination and geothermal projects in the Middle East and Indonesia.
